metadata.title: ईसाई आदिवासियों का आरक्षण ख़त्म करने की माँग | Delisting of christian tribals | Adivasi Daily
metadata.description: Adivasi Daily is a news bulletin programme of Main Bhi Bharat. In Todays Episode watch tribal Folk dance of bodo tribe assam. Odisha Tribal girl molestion, report of public accounts committee on Tribal Sub plan. MP's demand inclusion of various castes in schedule tribe list.
